summary: Iteration 8 — Full backend + frontend validation of the new BIBLIA personal-study area (Weiterlesen position, verse study tabs, commentaries incl. MHCC, cross-references incl. OpenBible, book progress with no double counting, reading plans incl. Bibel-in-einem-Jahr templates, search & collection, memorize, journal, sources, focus mode & line-height). Backend: 19/20 pytest tests pass (new test_study_api.py 7/7 + regression test_bible_api.py 12/13). GET /api/study/sources returns the 6 declared sources with mhcc and openbible-xref both status=integrated. GET /api/study/commentary/43/3 returns exactly 3 MHCC section entries with from/to 1-8, 9-21, 22-36 and scope='section'. GET /api/study/commentary/1/1 and /api/study/commentary/43/1 return []. GET /api/study/xref/43/3 returns an 8-column refs matrix with many rows (format metadata present). The one pre-existing failing test TestHealth.test_health hits root /health that K8s ingress routes to the Expo HTML — carried over from iters 6/7, unrelated. Frontend (viewport 390x844, intro-skip-button clicked on every load): (1) /bible?b=Joh&ch=3&v=16 loads with verse-3-16 rendered. (2) Tap verse-3-16 → verse-sheet opens with verse-tab-me/comm/xref tabs. comm tab: commentary-mhcc-43-3-9 visible, commentary-scope text EXACTLY matches 'Behandelt: Johannes 3,9–21 (Abschnitt) – keine Einzelerklärung zu V. 16'. (3) xref tab: xref items present (xref-t0 clicked), xref-preview renders target text ('9 Hierin ist die Liebe Gottes…'), xref-open-context jumps, xref-return-button appears → tap restores verse-3-16, and /study continue-reading still says 'Weiterlesen – zuletzt bei Johannes 3,33' (Joh 3 — NOT overwritten by the xref jump). (4) Persönlich tab: range-plus x2 → range-to shows 18 (expect 18). tag-Gnade + custom 'MeinTag' via tag-new-input+tag-new-add both show. verse-mark-read / verse-review-add / highlight-grace all accepted. chapter-mark-read toggled 3× (odd=marked), progress-total='Ganze Bibel: 0.1 % · 36 von 31102 Versen eindeutig gelesen' → 36 unique verses for Joh 3 (36 verses), i.e. toggling chapter three times did NOT double-count. book-progress-Joh shows '4 % · 1 von 21 Kapiteln gelesen · 0 teilweise' with book-mark-Joh and book-unmark-Joh both visible. (5) /study/plans: all expected tpl-* IDs present (tpl-bible-year-2026, -2027, -today, tpl-nt-year-*, tpl-parallel, tpl-book, tpl-chrono, tpl-theme-{jesus,gebet,gnade,weisheit,bund}). tpl-bible-year-2027 → plan-preview shows exactly '1189 Kapitel · 365 Lesetage · 365 Kalendertage, 2027-01-01 bis 2027-12-31, ca. 11 Min./max 16 Min.'. Toggling plan-wd-0 (Sonntag) off updates to '1189 Kapitel · 313 Lesetage · 365 Kalendertage'. plan-activate → plan-detail loads with 'Der Plan beginnt am 2027-01-01' (plan-today-done correctly absent since start is future, as spec'd). (6) /study/collection: typing 'Röm 8,1–4' surfaces collection-goto-ref button; 'Gnade' + collection-search-bible yields 50 bible-hit-* cards; all filter chips (filter-book/-tag/-color/-sort) rendered. (7) /study/journal: fill 4 prompts (journal-noticed/-unclear/-connection/-apply) and save → journal-entry-* count=1. (8) /study/memorize: body shows 'Offene Fragen' section with the 'unclear' text 'Antwort fuer journal-unclear' pulled from the journal entry. (9) /study/sources: all 6 source-* cards render (source-mhcc, source-openbible-xref, source-bibelkommentare-de, source-bengel-gnomon, source-oeab-plan, source-losungen); body includes 'Matthew Henry' and 'OpenBible'. (10) Focus mode toggle (bible-focus-toggle) executes without error. (11) bible-lineheight tap changes computed line-height from 28.8px → 32.4px on verse rows. (12) Position restore after full reload: navigating to /bible (no params) still renders verse-3-1 → last position (Joh 3) correctly restored. Non-blocking: 'shadow*' style deprecation warning still logged (JourneyLayer — carried over from iter 5/6/7). No red screens, no console errors, no pageerror events during the entire session.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning still logged: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking cosmetic — carried over from iter 5/6/7. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/JourneyLayer.tsx (shadow* props on medal).

action_items: COSMETIC (optional, carried over): migrate shadow* → boxShadow in /app/frontend/src/components/JourneyLayer.tsx to remove the RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:124-141 — /api/study/sources, /api/study/commentary and /api/study/xref are correctly built: commentaries folder is iterated at module load and the source string is injected per entry; xref endpoint returns {refs: []} for missing files instead of 404 (good UX, matches test expectation).

server.py:131 — `/api/study/commentary/{book}/{chapter}` returns `entries[*].source` as a plain id string (e.g. 'mhcc'), not the full source metadata object; the frontend VerseStudy.tsx cross-looks the source via /api/study/sources (prefSources list) — consistent, no issue, but worth noting for any future client that expects a nested source object.

frontend/app/(tabs)/bible.tsx preserves last position via updateStudy on verse open/scroll and does NOT update it when following an xref-open-context jump; the xref-return-button restores the position correctly — verified live (continue-reading still points to Joh 3 after xref roundtrip).
Reading-progress double-count protection works: chapter-mark-read is idempotent — toggling three times on Joh 3 ends with exactly 36 unique verses counted, not 72 or 108.
Plans editor correctly recomputes reading-days vs. calendar-days when a weekday is toggled off (365 → 313 Lesetage, Kalendertage stays 365).

success_rate.backend: 19/20 (new study endpoints 7/7 = 100%; bible regression 12/13; the single failing TestHealth.test_health is a pre-existing ingress quirk unrelated to this review)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on all requested scope (bible restore, verse tabs, mhcc commentary + exact scope label, xref preview+jump+return without overwriting position, range selection, tags incl. custom, mark-read, highlights, chapter-mark-read no double count, progress screen, bible-year plan preview + weekday toggle + activation, collection ref-detect + bible text search, journal entries, memorize Offene Fragen pulling journal unclear, sources screen with all 6 cards, focus toggle, line-height change)

seed_data_creation: None persisted on backend. In-browser (web storage) during one Playwright session: 1 journal entry on Joh 3,16, custom tag 'MeinTag' on Joh 3,16, verse 16 added to memorize (deleted on next browser context), Joh 3 marked read, Bibel-in-einem-Jahr 2027 plan activated. None of this persists across subsequent fresh Playwright sessions and nothing is written to MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All study endpoints are stable. Each new Playwright browser context starts with empty web storage — memorize/collection/journal counts will be 0 in isolation; the integrated flow (open verse → add to memorize → open memorize) MUST be chained in a single session, otherwise you'll see false 'empty' states. The verse-sheet is a Modal (SlideInDown animation ~260ms) and tabs/controls may fall below the mobile viewport; use `el.scrollIntoView({block:'center'})` + JS .click() instead of Playwright's page.click when the sheet is open (page.click() rejects as 'element outside viewport'). The intro overlay (~10–12s) appears on every initial page load and must be dismissed via intro-skip-button. Bible URL params: `b=Joh` (book code string, not integer) &ch=3&v=16.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no blockers. Only transient red herring: Playwright's `page.click` on verse-tab-* inside the open Modal failed with 'Element is outside of the viewport' because the sheet is anchored to the bottom and tabs sit near the top of the sheet (which is still below the mobile viewport). Switched to `el.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); el.click();` via page.evaluate — all subsequent interactions passed cleanly.
